### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** a16d345be601da64e5f60a8974f1b92ca475b296
* **affected area:** worktree lifecycle cleanup — plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe, worktree-cleanup.sh, cleanup-claude-session.sh, resolve-abandoned-worktrees.sh, end-session SKILL.md
* **host:** darwin; worktree parent dir /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (internal dogfooding)

#### Expected Behavior

After a session ends, the session's worktree should be removed once its branch is merged to main. claude-safe (the session wrapper) and/or end-session should remove the worktree directory and prune the git worktree registration so worktrees do not accumulate.

#### Actual Behavior

23 worktree directories are present under /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/. Two distinct orphan classes observed:

(A) TRUE orphan directories not registered in `git worktree list` and lacking a .git entry — pure leftover dirs git cannot prune:
  - cleanup/                       (mtime 2026-05-20)
  - followup/                      (mtime 2026-05-20)
  - worktree-20260318-154530/      (mtime 2026-03-18, ~2.5 months old)

(B) Registered-but-stale worktrees whose branches are FULLY MERGED into main yet were never removed after session end (sample):
  - worktree-20260524-112235, feat/visual-eval-workflow-integration, fix-audit-findings,
    fix/tmpdir-isolation-anti-pattern, worktree-20260528-085216, worktree-20260528-165839,
    hooks-hardening-to-main-20260530, worktree-20260530-185025, fix-f148-pr-b-json-only-retry,
    fix-gate-llm-reviews-on-tests, fixup-pr496-blue-team, fix-g2-and-pr482-nits
  (~12 merged worktrees still present; merge state confirmed via `git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> main`)

### 3. Action History

Observed during interactive session in worktree-20260530-191623. Enumerated via:
  - `git worktree list` (23 entries incl. main, .tickets-tracker, /tmp advisory-lock temp)
  - `ls -d .../digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/*/` (23 dirs on disk)
  - per-branch `git merge-base --is-ancestor` merge classification

#### Impact

Disk + git-metadata accumulation; stale worktrees confuse worktree-aware tooling and slow `git worktree list`. Class (A) cannot be cleaned by `git worktree prune` since git has no record of them.
data.title: [worktree-cleanup]: session end and claude-safe do not remove merged/stale worktrees -> orphan worktree dirs accumulate
